Stone Energy successfully completed zone change operations on SS 112, OCS-00066, Well W-2.  The depleted "R-11" Sand was isolated by setting a plug @ 11150' MD and dumping ~60' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 11090'.  The "R-9" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 10906' - 10916' MD & 10856' - 10872' MD. Operations began on July 22, 2009, and ended on July 30, 2009.

Stone Energy successfully performed zone change operations to produce the "C-1" Sand in SS 98, Well #2BP1.  Operations began on August 16, 2009 and ended on August 29, 2009.  The previous producing interval, the "D-2" Sand, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 12350' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 12300' MD.  The "C-1" Sand was then perforated from 9409' to 9413' MD.

ERT has successfully performed the initial completion operations of the EC 346 A12ST4 well.  Drilling operations began on 08-26-09, with the well TD'd at 9564' MD / 9439' TVD, w/a MW of 14.6 ppg SBM on 
09-12-09.  

The well was completed for production on 10-07-09.  The well was completed as a single, gravel packed, oil completion in the "Lentic 1-3" Sand with perforations of 9440' - 9494' MD.

Stone Energy on behalf of Forest Oil has completed operations on the VR 267 OCS-G 01977, Well C03. An attempt to squeeze with cement the "K-1" Sand compaletion perforations, 10054' - 10062' MD, failed and resulted with a cement plug in the 2 7/8" production tubing from 5900' - 5000'.

Permanently isolated D-10 Sand, and added perfs to D-2 Sand.  The long string tubing was perforated at the same time the casing was perforated, and the D-2 sand is now flowing up the long string (short string tubing remains out of service due to mechanical problems).

Stone Energy successfully performed zone change operations on EI 243, OCS-G-02899, Well D-1ST to produce the "OW Upper" Sand.  Operations began on October 1, 2009 and were completed on October 6, 2009.  The previous producing interval, the "OW Lower" Sand, perfs 12962' - 12982' MD, was isolated by setting a BP @ 12825' and dumping 18' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 12807'.  The "OW Upper" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 12770' - 12800'.

The artifical lift operations to enhance production in the P Sand were completed on 12/28/2009. Please change the completion status of the P Sand to Gas Lift Oil. See attached As-Run Wellbore Schematic for your records.

Zone change operations on ST 34, OCS-G-04842, Well A-2ST1 have been suspended.  Operations began on February 11, 2010 and ended on February 26, 2010.  The previous completion interval, the "R-3" Sand was successfully isolated by setting a TTVBP @ 12405' MD & dumping cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 12356' MD.  It was then discovered that the production pkr @ 12207' MD is leaking and operations were suspended.  Note: There is no sustained csg pressure on the well.  An APM to address the leaking pkr @ 12207' MD and complete zone change operation to expose the "R-1" Sand to production, proposed perfs 12332' - 12350' MD, will be filed at a later date.  Per EOR database requirements, the well status has been noted as temporarily abandoned.

The MC 109 A15ST1 was spud on 04-18-10.  The well was drilled to a total depth of 9656' MD / 6063' TVD w/a MW of 12.4 ppg SBM.  Hole problems and lost circulation problems were encounted. The well was plugged back for by-pass operations.

The well was plugged back by setting an inflatable cmt retainer @ 5109' MD and setting 1524' balance cmt plug on top of the retainer, ETOC @ 3585'.  A 9 5/8" EZSV was then set at 3438' and 400 sxs of cmt were squeezed below to retainer to set a cmt plug from 3585' - 3438'MD.  Operations were completed on the well on 05-25-10.

The EI 302 w#04 well was spud on 04-23-10 and drilled to a total depth of 9950' MD / TVD on 04-24-10, w/a MW of 16.2 ppg.   7 5/8" prod. csg was set at TD and the well was then temporarily abandoned via a mud line suspension system.  TA operations were completed on 05-31-10 and the rig moved off location on 06-04-10.

Leed Petroleum LLC has successfully completed operations on the EI 183 A4 to add perforations to the existing "Tex X-2" Sand completion.
Perfs were added from 13654' - 13660' MD.

Operations began on 05-02-10 and were completed on 05-04-10.

An RPM will be submitted to reopen the change zone WAR.

Workover and abandonment permitting for Ship Shoal 64 #001 submitted retroactively per BOEM engineers Casey Bisso and Brad Hunter.

Modify Perforations in the PL-9A by thru-tubing perforations from 11936'-11944'.  Set EZSV @ 11968'. Sqz perfs w/5 bbls cmt f/11974'-12018'. Test to 3000 psi. Set CIBP @ 11958'. Test to 2800 psi.  Pumped 19 bbls for cmt pkr from 10850'-11450'.  Perf tbg from 11936'-11944' in the PL-9A.

Upon mobilizaton to the Ship Shoal 198 G Platform and subject G3 well, it was determined that the well had been sidetracked at a previous date.  Further investigation determined that an APM had been submitted by Continental Oil Company to the USGS to drill the G6 well as a sidetrack out of the G3 wellbore on March 10, 1969. The subsequent spud date for the G06 well was 03/26/1969 with a TD date of 04/08/1969.  Completed operations on the G Platform included the successful plug and abandonment of the G6 well.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the SS 93 #8ST1 well to produce the "M-11" Sd. The previous completion, the "M-12" sd, was abandoned by sqeezing cement into the existing perfs, leaving the ETOC at 14,700' MD. The "M-11" sd was then exposed to production by perforating the intervals of 14,432'-14,457' & 14,470'-14,498' MD. Operations began on 08-25-10 and were completed on 09-05-10.

Due to the 9-5/8-inch and 13-3/8-inch casings being grouted together, McMoRan could not remove the casing strings.  McMoRan received approval from Cliff DeLouche on 08/24/2010 to set a 9-5/8-inch CIBP at 259-ft MD (85-ft BML) + 50-ft of cement leaving TOC at 209-ft (35-ft BML).

An attempt to zone change to produce the "T-10" sand was unsuccessful. The previous sand completion, the "U-1" sand, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 12905' MD and dumped cmt to 12848' MD. Operations to complete the zone change to the "T-10" sand were suspended when it was determined that the production packer at 11860' may be leaking. Operations began 09/08/2010 and ended 09/16/2010.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the SS 99 A1ST1 well to produce the "R-1" sd. The previous completion, the "S-1" sd, was isolated by setting a TTVBP @ 12,700' MD  and dumping 54' of cmt on top of TTVBP, w/ ETOC @ 12,646' MD. The "R-1" sd was then exposed to production by perforating the intervals of 12,342'-12,366' MD. Operations began on 09/18/2010 and were completed on 09/23/2010.

Stone has completed zone change operations on the VR 46 A-10 well, but failed to produce the "Big A-3" sand. The previous completion, the "Big A-4" sand, was isolated by setting a cast iron bridge plug @ 7,465' MD and dumping 57' cmt on top of CIBP, ETOC @ 7,408' MD. Attempts to establish production from the "Big A-3" sand after punching holes in the concentric isolation assembly at 7,350'-7,354' MD & 7,341'-7346' MD  and exposing the perforations of the "Big A-3" Sand, failed.  The completion did not flow.   Operations began on 09/29/2010 and ended 10/06/2010.

Efforts to recomplete the subject well from the 7600' Sand to the Lower 7900' Sand have been suspended due to failure to fish lost wireline tools. Secured well by setting a DX Pump Through Plug at 2990'.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the SS 112 V-4 well to produce the "R-14" sand. The previous completion, the "C-2" sand, was isolated by setting a CIBP @ 11,163' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the CIBP, w/ ETOC @ 11,113' MD. The "R-14" sand was exposed to production by perforating the intervals 10,870'-10,880' MD, 10,918'-10,930' MD, & 10,938'-10.950' MD. Operations began on 09/29/2010 and ended 10/18/2010.

hole), DHPT (down hole pressure/temperature gauges), and deep set SCSSV. An FMC horizontal tree (HXT) will be installed during this completion.

Stone has successfully completed plugback operations on the MC 28 Well A-19. An inflatable cement retainer was set at 7147' MD in the 9-5/8" casing. Cement was displaced and squeezed below the retainer with ETOC at 12650' MD. Cement was squeezed below the retainer at 7147' MD and cement dumped on top of the retainer w/ TOC at 6969' MD. Cement plug at 6969' MD was pressure tested to 1000 psi. Operations began 06-07-12 and ended 07-17-12.

Attempt to melt hydrate and conduct fishing operations.
Anadarko was successful in removing the hydrate blockage, and much of the slickline that was left in the A004. However, during the fishing operations with braided line, we got hung up and had to cut the braided line with a mechanical cutter. We were unsuccessful at retrieving this mechanical cutter and the braided line toolstring.  However, the current fish sits below the current perfs (C-Mac) and below the SCSSV.
We were able to return the C-Mac to production with gaslift from 8/15/12 to 8/23/12. However, the watercut was at 100% and it was decided to shut-in the well for the time being.

Intitial APM was to replace dummy valves with live gas lift valves.  A subsequent RPM was submitted to fish stuck tools that were lost in the hole while attempting to pull the standing valve once the gas lift valve work was complete.

Note: Decision was made to cease operations prior to running sand control due to difficulties running in & out of the wellbore w/ slickline & e-line. An informational e-mail was sent 06-13-2013 informing BSEE of this decision.

Coiled tubing zone change Operations were successfully completed on the EI 28 Well #006 to produce the "Upper Cib-Carst" Sand. The "Lower Cib-Carst" Sand was isolated setting a MRBP at 10,656' MD w/ 20' of cmt dump bailed on top of the plug; ETOC at 10,636 MD. Bridge plug & cmt plug were pressure tested to 3500 psi. A peddle basket was set at 10,520' MD w/ 17' cmt dump bailed on top of basket; ETOC at 10,503' MD. The "Upper Cib-Carst" Sand was exposed to production by perforating intervals 10,478'-10,490' MD/TVD. Operations started 06/03/2013 and ended 06/14/2013.

Shut-in EB 599 SS001. Record SITP. Using ROV, dive to 599 SS001 subsea tree and function open the hydraulic supply needle valves. Close the lower sleeve (BS-60 zone) from the platform control panel. Bleed ~500 psi off the tubing to the flowline. Monitor SITP for 1 hr for signs of leaking sleeves. Open the upper sleeve from the platform control panel. Using ROV, function closed the hydraulic supply needle valves on subsea tree. Depart ROV. Open 599 SS001 BS-58 zone to production.

The wellbore has storm plugs in place.
Temporarily well cap installed at 95.5'.
Note:  Casing stubs have been cut at 19' above water line not above mud line.  Above water line was not a drop down option.

The HI A-494 Well B-4(BP02) was drilled w/ the MODU, Diamond Ocean King. The well was spud on 08-25-13 and drilled to a TD of 14,790' MD / 14,509' TVD w/ a MW of 14.5 ppg at 15:30 hrs on 09-02-13.

While performing drilling operations to clean out the wellbore to set the 5" production liner, Rooster inadvertently wobbled out of hole and the BP02 wellbore collapsed at 14,264' MD / 13,941' TVD.

Per the approved APM, Anadarko permitted to attempt to open the XRFV in the Amp 2 Lower, flow test the Amp 2 Lower, and then change to the Amp 2 Upper. Anadarko was able to achieve a successful negative test. Anadarko is currently only producing the Amp 2 Upper.

Anadarko set the optional pump-thru plug in the XRFV to isolate the Amp 2 Lower. The plug was set above the Amp 2 Lower mechanical sleeve. The sleeve for the Amp 2 Lower is a Superior X-Radial Flow Valve. Anadarko achieved a successful test on the plug, so we know the Amp 2 Lower is isolated. 

First we ran a check set tool that showed the plug was actually set. Then we performed the negative test by pulling > 500 psi off the plug and holding.

Since Anadarko has the lower frac pack isolated via plug and the successful negative test, then a commingling application has not been submitted to date. Should Anadarko decide to produce both the Amp 2 Lower and Amp 2 Upper in the future, then BSEE-Rate Control would be consulted prior to doing so.

Cut 16" drive pipe on 2/21/14 to 15' BML. Length 68'- 26,550 lbs.

After testing of the new upper completion and establishing barriers, a new subsea tree was run using the LDIS system.

Rigged up the Pride 1502 rig on slot 7 EB 161 A-13.  TIH w/ 13-1/2" directional BHA, washed out the drive pipe with 8.6 ppg seawater and surveyed.  Directionally drilled w/ 13-1/2" BHA to 2,890' MD.  Ran and cemented 11-3/4" casing.  Installed 11-3/4" wellhead.  NU and tested 13-5/8" 10M BOPE, and Weatherford?s RCH.  TIH w/ 9-7/8? directional BHA.  Displace seawater to 10.8 ppg SBM and drilled out shoe track and 10? of new formation and ran LOT to 11.9 ppg.  Slide drilled to 5,964' MD.  Ran 7-3/4" casing tagging up at 5,219? MD.
